projection_rules.fact_id: slash-delimited public collection and field names; stable set identities are RFC3986-escaped path segments; ordered sequences use zero-padded ordinal indexes
projection_rules.sets: plugins are ordered by accepted load order; override contributions, masters, providers, and links with ordinals are ordered sequences; maps and semantic sets are sorted by their named stable identity
projection_rules.duplicates: duplicate fact IDs, map identities, plugin names, load orders, member IDs, provider-chain paths, and provider IDs are invalid at their owning contract boundary
projection_rules.form_keys: eight lowercase hexadecimal local-ID digits, colon, lowercase plugin filename with esm, esp, or esl extension
projection_rules.numbers: integers compare as exact signed JSON integers; placement floats compare as finite IEEE-754 values serialized with invariant round-trip formatting; negative zero canonicalizes as JSON numeric zero
projection_rules.null_missing: a projected null is an explicit typed null fact; a missing projected fact is a missing_fact product mismatch; an unexpected projected fact is an extra_fact mismatch
projection_rules.included: named Slice 4 state, plugin, record/contribution, override/winner, NPC, RACE, REFR, link, field-presence, participant, FaceGen/provider topology, taxonomy, coverage, gap, and stable failure-code fields
projection_rules.excluded: physical paths, SnapshotAuthorizedPath, source snapshot IDs, dependency fingerprints, producer/build metadata outside tuple identity, timestamps, exception messages, Reason or Message prose, display text, redundant manifest hashes and lengths, and incidental serialization fields

terminal_rules.PASS: every validly admitted corpus member and assertion passes
terminal_rules.FAIL: all members are validly admitted and at least one candidate execution, candidate-output contract, state, fact, or value assertion fails
terminal_rules.EVALUATOR_ERROR: manifest, tuple, retained bytes, evaluator identity/dependency, oracle admission, result publication, or other evaluator infrastructure is invalid; no aggregate product verdict

identity.evaluator_files_fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical relative_path|byte_length|sha256 lines in ordinal relative-path order
identity.executing_binary: the actual executing Infinium.EvaluatorV2.dll must be the declared file under the declared evaluator root; the deps graph and every required public schema/protocol file must be declared and byte-matched
identity.candidate: candidate assembly and every declared non-framework dependency are byte-matched before invocation; candidate load context permits no undeclared non-framework fallback

privacy: member identities, local paths, raw candidate outputs, oracles, and assertions remain private; sanitized aggregate output exposes only tuple identities, aggregate member/assertion counts, public failure categories, and the permitted terminal stage
